question: How is a greed-driven and fickle approach to Kula scripture characterized?
premises: A seeker motivated by greed is described.
Such a person is always fickle.
This attitude is called a mockery of Kula scripture.
inference: A greed-driven and fickle seeker makes a mockery of the Kula scripture.
plain_english: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
